title: Pretty Neat Potions & Trinkets
description: Pretty Neat Potions & Trinkets adds a small collection of potions and wearable curios trinkets that shake up gameplay in fun, slightly chaotic ways.
body:
**Pretty Neat Potions & Trinkets** adds a small collection of potions and wearable items that focus on luck, utility, and changing how mobs interact with players.

⚠ **_This Mod Requires Curios_** ⚠

🍀 Luck Potions

Introduces multiple tiers of Luck potions that can be brewed and upgraded through vanilla-style brewing. These potions affect anything that uses the Luck attribute, such as loot tables and fishing, and are designed to work well alongside loot- and exploration-focused mods. Splash versions are included to share effects with nearby players.

🐱 Catnip

A unique potion effect that causes creepers to actively avoid affected players. This makes mining and cave exploration safer without completely removing danger. A wearable Catnip Charm is also included, providing a constant version of this effect while equipped. But be careful as if you get too cocky or surprise the creepers, they might still blow up in your face.

✨ Blessed

Grants short-term regeneration while causing common hostile mobs like zombies and skeletons to avoid the player. To balance this, the effect also applies weakness, encouraging movement and positioning rather than direct combat.

👻 Haunted

A high-risk, high-reward effect that causes villagers and animals to flee, while iron golems become hostile on sight. In exchange, the player gains bursts of strength along with longer-lasting slowness. 

🐟 Fishy

A simple but chaotic potion that applies poison. While mostly a stepping gate into luck, its splash versions can be used to poison nearby players, making it useful for pranks, PvP scenarios, or general mischief.

🧿 Trinkets (Curios Required)

This mod requires Curios and adds wearable trinkets (or, "charms") that provide passive utility effects, such as slow falling or mob avoidance, or resource based effects. Trinkets are designed to be helpful without replacing enchantments or armor.

⚙️ Config Options
This mod also allows for the player to tune luck potions' durations, disable mob avoidance behaviour of either catnip or the other potions or even configure the radius in which mob avoid the player.

More trinkets, config options and additional features are planned for future updates.

If you have feedback, bug reports, or suggestions, feel free to DM me on Discord: **itwaskairo**
